versions.changelog:
- Skill renamed from "sticker-cog" to "sticker-generator-cellcog" for clearer identification.
- Updated description for clarity and accuracy in both metadata and documentation.
- Documentation in SKILL.md received minor content tweaks but all features and usage remain unchanged.
- Removed redundant file "skill-card.md" for maintenance simplification.

- Shortened and clarified the skill description for readability.
- Updated usage instructions: made the distinction between OpenClaw and other agents clearer.
- No changes to code or features; documentation only.
- Retained all examples, use cases, and style guides with minor formatting improvements.

**Expanded platform support and usage documentation**

- Updated the description to emphasize AI-powered sticker and emoji generation, broader platform support, and batch generation.
- Revised usage instructions with an explicit `from cellcog import CellCogClient` example for integration clarity.
- Description, feature list, and prompt examples now cover custom stickers, emoji sets, and platform-ready packaging for WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, and pets/mascots.
- No code changes; documentation only.

- README (SKILL.md) simplified and streamlined for clarity and faster reference.
- Description reduced for brevity; still highlights key features: CellCog-powered, platform-ready sticker packs, consistent characters, transparent backgrounds.
- Usage and prerequisites condensed, with prominent direction to the main cellcog skill for full SDK/API details.
- Retains detailed prompt examples, style tables, and common use cases for various sticker/emoji packs.
- Removed lengthy introductory/duplicative material for improved readability. No code or API changes.

- Documentation updated in SKILL.md; content unchanged otherwise.
- No feature, performance, or bug fixes in this release.

Version 1.0.1 of sticker-cog – improved documentation and clarity

- SKILL.md significantly expanded and rewritten for greater clarity on what makes sticker-cog unique.
- Stronger emphasis on character/brand consistency across all generated stickers.
- More example prompts and detailed prompt templates for WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, and iMessage sticker/emoji sets.
- Clearer explanation of typical use cases: mascot packs, team emoji, pet/self-portrait stickers, professional reactions.
- Added tables comparing style options, difficulty in sticker pack creation, and output recommendations for each platform.
- No changes to functionality or code; documentation only.

- Initial release of sticker-cog skill.
- Generate character-consistent sticker packs and custom emoji sets with transparent backgrounds.
- Supports batch creation and outputs in PNG, WebP, or SVG for WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, and more.
- Offers a variety of art styles, including kawaii, cartoon, pixel art, anime, and more.
- Includes platform-specific packaging and size guidelines.
- Requires the cellcog skill for setup and API access.
